claims: BTS is releasing their 5th studio album ARIRANG on March 20, 2026.
BTS concert titled "BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG" takes place on March 21, 2026, at 8 pm KST at Gwanghwamun Square, Seoul.
The concert is exclusively streamed on Netflix.
THE RETURN premieres on Netflix on March 27, 2026.
BTS has an 82-date world tour scheduled from April 2026 through March 2027.
Tickets for the world tour are already sold out.
The concert at Gwanghwamun Square is organized by BIGHIT MUSIC/HYBE.
Netflix holds exclusive rights to stream the concert to a global audience.
According to Korea JoongAng Daily, Seoul is celebrating the return with pop-up stores and drone shows.
RM shared with GQ via Rolling Stone that the focus is on being back together and seeing fans worldwide.
The comeback marks BTS's first full-group activity after completing mandatory military service.
The release of ARIRANG and the subsequent world tour represent BTS's first full-group musical endeavor in nearly four years
